more_info.overview: Chlorine is an elemental substance used for oxidative treatment in certain food-manufacturing processes. The US flour standard specifically identifies chlorine as a bleaching and artificial-ageing agent. This entry concerns treatment of flour during manufacture. It should be distinguished from chlorine compounds with different compositions and separately regulated applications.
more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US permission is limited to the uses and conditions in 21 CFR 137.105, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.uses: Permitted in the US for specified flour bleaching or ageing treatments, subject to the applicable standard of identity.
